function.name: update_planning_topic
function.description: Create or replace one site-level planning topic by stable ID. Pass the complete topic under item, not as top-level fields: { item: { id, kind, question, context, status, impact, resolveBefore, ... }, expectedUpdatedAt? }. Follow the tool schema for required fields and enums; title is not a topic field. Read an existing item before updating it; pass the response updatedAt as expectedUpdatedAt and preserve its unrelated fields. Omit expectedUpdatedAt only when creating a new ID. On TOPICS_CHANGED, reread and merge with the current answer and confirmation evidence; never retry the stale item blindly. Use open for a question or assumption, answered for an unconfirmed answer, and confirmed/dismissed only when the user explicitly confirmed the answer or dismissed the topic; quote that response in confirmationEvidence. AI suggestions alone are not confirmation. This records discussion only: it does not update Blueprint/App Plan or authorize implementation.

question.description: The business question to clarify, including for an assumption.

suggestion.description: Proposed answer or assumption; null when there is no suggestion.

status.description: open, answered, confirmed or dismissed. Answered is still unconfirmed.

confirmationEvidence.description: User's explicit confirmation or dismissal and its context; required for confirmed/dismissed, otherwise null. This is a discussion record, not an authorization token.

resolveBefore.description: app-plan-creation, implementation or production-release. Unconfirmed items block the named stage and later stages.

artifact.description: site, blueprint or app-plan; categorizes the discussion without embedding it in that document.

relatedIds.description: Related business/planning object IDs for navigation; may refer to objects not planned yet.

milestoneIds.description: Restrict implementation blocking to these Milestone IDs; empty applies to all. Does not restrict the app-plan-creation gate.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: Required for replacing an existing topic: copy updatedAt from the latest read_planning_topics response. Omit only for a new ID. TOPICS_CHANGED requires rereading and merging with current user answers before retrying.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
